findings.note: In a Nov 23 update, Tatum scored 27 in 38 minutes against the Warriors. He has scored 20+ in eight straight games and is averaging 25.9 points in that span, so his recent output is right at the 25.5 line and he is still Boston's main scorer. No injury was mentioned.

ESPN lists Tatum at 26.4 PPG this season on 42.6% shooting, but only 23.9 PPG on the road (9 games, 38.4% FG, 32.0% from three). That road split is below the 25.5 line. This page and ESPN's game page show different team records.

The Wizards allow 115.8 points per game, which points to an easy scoring matchup and works against the Under. ESPN's predictor gives Boston a 77.9% win chance, so a blowout could cut Tatum's minutes. The game is an NBA Cup group-play game, and no injury news was found.
